good_thing: Grand Island, New York: Twenty Mitten Project volunteers helped organize cold-weather items made and donated for neighbors in western New York. The project made more than 1,800 pieces in 2025 and another 700 so far in 2026, supporting 30 local organizations, schools, and charities.
current_or_history: On August 18, 1587, Virginia Dare was born on Roanoke Island, in what is now North Carolina. She was the first English child born in North America; almost nothing is known of her life after her grandfather John White left the colony that became known as the Lost Colony.
tiny_fact: Jupiter has a moon called Dia with a radius of about 1.2 miles. Discovered in 2000, it was lost in Jupiter’s glare for several years before telescope images from 2010 and 2011 found it again.
thought: Small acts can be useful long before anyone thinks to count them.
